theme: SIP fundamentals: power of compounding, rupee cost averaging
headline: Small steps, big wealth through consistent investing
body: Investing regularly harnesses compounding's power while smoothing market volatility through rupee cost averaging over time.
caption: When you invest fixed amounts regularly, you buy more units when prices dip and fewer when they rise. This disciplined approach removes emotion from investing. #SIPFundamentals #RupeeCostAveraging #CompoundingPower #SmartInvesting #WealthBuilding
